name: Swain's Cay Lodge
brand_truth: An Orvis-endorsed bonefishing lodge on Mangrove Cay, between the Middle and South Bights of Andros, with a wadeable flat off its own beach.
buyer: Serious fly anglers (US, 40-70), repeat groups of friends, father-son trips and couples with a non-angling partner, comparing Andros lodges.

design.hero_pattern: sunrise-disc monument: huge serif name with the real lodge photo in a rising circle over a drawn horizon line
design.signature: 'Where you'll fish' illustrated chart (home flat, Middle Bight, South Bight, Andros Barrier Reef, 6,000 ft drop) with method and species per water; trip planner counting boats and recommended gratuities composing the enquiry email; room switcher on lodge page

current_site_findings: About page images load from 'localhost/swainscaytest' and are broken for visitors.
Fishing guide button opens the 2024-2025 PDF while the page lists 2026-2027 rates.
Generic homepage headline without bonefishing, Andros or Mangrove Cay.
Eight repeated special-offer blocks bury rooms, fishing and contact.
Orvis endorsement and the home flat are barely visible.
Package math (boats, guides, gratuities) left to a PDF.
pitch_line: Your About page is showing broken images from a test server; this concept leads with what anglers actually book on: your waters, your guides, and the full cost of a week.
assumptions: Chart is illustrative: relative placement of lodge, home flat, bights and reef not verified
Orvis endorsement current (logo in their header)
Guest quotes and staff names on their site come from third-party reviews; not used on the concept
notes: Current site was rebuilt in Sept 2026 by Hotel Traffic Builders, so the pitch is improvement, not rescue: lead with the broken localhost images and stale PDF. Index booking uses a custom planner rather than shadcn Tabs (single enquiry type: fishing week); room booking links to their engine. Scorecard: 1:4 2:5 3:4 4:5 5:4 6:4 7:5 8:4 9:4 10:5 11:4.
